1 · Intro

When to use it.

Every hire starts with a position. The requisition is built from it, and the new hire's assignment inherits from it, so a mistake here follows the person all the way through.

Before you start, have the approved position description from your engagement consultant and the pre-search memo from Compensation. The memo gives you the job code, title, level, and assignment category.

Use this whenYou need a new position to recruit and hire into.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Fields that get positions sent back
FieldDo this
Standard working hoursAlways 40. Put actual hours in Working hours.
JobSix-digit code from the memo. No four- or five-digit codes (except VTS).
Assignment categoryNever Professional salaried non-exempt. VTS is always temporary.
ManagerLeave blank.
AttachmentsPre-search memo (required) and position description.

Watch-outs

  • Don't reactivate an inactive position. Old job codes on it can block updates and approval. Create a new one.
  • Don't repurpose an unused position that was built for a different worker type (for example, a student position for staff). Create a new one.
  • The requisition copies the position when it is submitted. Fix the position before you create the requisition.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • Oracle: Jobs and Positions (Using Global Human Resources) (opens in a new tab)

HCM Academy job aid · Position Management

Create a position

Use when: You need a new position to recruit and hire into. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Open Positions.
  2. Click Add (or Create).
  3. Effective date: today, not the start date.
  4. Status: Active. Action reason: New Position.
  5. Business unit, name, and code.
  6. Work unit: the department.
  7. Job: enter the six-digit job code from the pre-search memo.
  8. Location: where the person would sit on site.
  9. Assignment category: the one on the memo.
  10. Hours: keep Standard working hours at 40; set Working hours to the actual hours.
  11. Headcount and type.
  12. Overlap allowed: Yes. Then set Term or Flex if it applies.
    • Temporary: six months or less.
    • Term: a fixed role longer than six months, up to a year.
    • Flex: needed only part of the year, such as summer help who return each year. Usually non-exempt; set as temporary with 20 working hours so benefits don't kick in.
  13. Attach the pre-search memo and position description, add comments, and click Submit.
Fields that get positions sent back
FieldDo this
Standard working hoursAlways 40. Put actual hours in Working hours.
JobSix-digit code from the memo. No four- or five-digit codes (except VTS).
Assignment categoryNever Professional salaried non-exempt. VTS is always temporary.
ManagerLeave blank.
AttachmentsPre-search memo (required) and position description.

Watch-outs

  • Don't reactivate an inactive position. Old job codes on it can block updates and approval. Create a new one.
  • Don't repurpose an unused position that was built for a different worker type (for example, a student position for staff). Create a new one.
  • The requisition copies the position when it is submitted. Fix the position before you create the requisition.
